general_feeling: Mucho más cómoda de lo que pensaba. Lo que má miedo daba era que alguien se molestase porque pensara que le grababa.
challenges: A veces se podía hacer molesta en el caballete de la nariz, pero solo después de un tiempo.
act_impact: En el metro y en el musical el domingo donde seguridad me las hizo retirar.
beh_adapt: Intenté adaptarme y hacer mi vida. Socialmente se aceptó. Intenté parecer que no grababa.
social: Dos personas me preguntaron sobre el experimento (metro y supermercado) y en el musical me las hicieron quitar.
improvements: La idea que traslada a la gente es que parece una g-pro lo que está encima. Quizás se podría cambiar el diseño.
change_behavior: Ha sido interesante darme cuenta de la poca luz natural que recibimos y de lo inactiva que he estado esta semana sin darme cuenta.
general_feeling_english: Much more comfortable than I expected. What worried me most was that someone might feel uncomfortable because they thought I was recording them.
challenges_english: Sometimes it could become uncomfortable on the bridge of the nose, but only after a while.
act_impact_english: On the subway and at the musical on Sunday, where security made me take them off.
beh_adapt_english: I tried to adapt and carry on with my life. Socially it was accepted. I tried to look as though I wasn't recording.
social_english: Two people asked me about the experiment (on the subway and at the supermarket) and at the musical they made me take them off.
improvements_english: What it suggests to people is that the thing on top looks like a GoPro. Maybe the design could be changed.
change_behavior_english: It has been interesting to realise how little natural light we have received, and how inactive I have been this week without noticing.
